name: zclass_light_compute_world_transform
description: zClass_Light::ComputeWorldTransform rebuilds a light node's world-space position, optional orientation, and direction vector from the current node-to-ancestor matrix.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this light transform helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass light/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x453620 validates matrix-stack push/load-identity, gwNode::BuildNodeToAncestorMatrix(node, 1), local point sampling at {0,0,0} and {0,0,-1}, point/spot mode orientation derivation with zMath::Vec3DirectionAnglesBetweenPoints and zero z rotation, world-position writeback, current-matrix z-axis negation into worldDir, matrix-stack pop, and zero return.
The native light smoke verifies non-point world-position and default direction output, plus the point-mode world-rotation path, using zClass_Light::gwLightNew initialized data.
